name: GMV Winlet 1000 Crawler ER
summary: Tracked, fully hydraulic glazing robot with an extended telescopic arm that lifts windows and glass of up to 1,000 kg to just over 6 m, levelling itself automatically on slopes. Made by GMV A/S in Denmark.

germany.statusNote: GMV A/S (Bredsten, Denmark) sells Winlet glazing robots direct and has German-language product pages with a quote form and phone line. The Winlet range starts at EUR 24,600; the price of this model is not published. No German dealer is named.

sellers.name: GMV A/S
sellers.note: Office and production: Industriparken 1, DK-7182 Bredsten. German quote form on the product page; demonstrations on request.

specs.label: Maximum lifting height
specs.conditions: product page: maximum horizontal lifting height just over 6 m

specs.label: Drive
specs.value: tracks with automatic self-levelling; fully hydraulic

specs.label: Outriggers needed
specs.conditions: low ground pressure, works without outriggers (maker)

notes: Maker says it can be driven on all kinds of terrain including stairs, with minimal ground pressure and without outriggers.
Extended-reach version of the Winlet 1000 Crawler; vacuum lifting frame on a telescopic arm.
Weight, dimensions, battery and runtime are in the maker's catalogue PDF, which could not be read.
